inverse: Universe U consists of pairs (candidate implementation, claimed Boolean completion outcome) for this fixed bounded assertion suite, under terminating ordinary execution. R contains exactly pairs whose claim equals conjunction of the suite assertions. The behavior complement is U minus R, including false pass and false failure claims. Behavior on untested inputs is unconstrained; finite acceptance is not universal correctness.

Given a passing test transcript, the compatible antecedents are every implementation agreeing on all enumerated assertions; behavior elsewhere remains unconstrained. A failed named assertion restricts the antecedent to implementations violating that concrete predicate, without unique bug localization.
limitations: Partial syntax has no macro expansion or type resolution. Bounded evidence is not proof. Allocation failures are outside the Result contract. No approximate executable profiles.
